PROTECTED AREAS AND PROTECTED PLACES
ORDINANCE, 1959

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Protected Areas
and Protected Places Ordinance, 1959, the Minister charged with
responsibility for internal security hereby makes the following order:

1. This order may be cited as the Protected Places (Amendment)
Order, 1973.

2. Item 11 in the Schedule to the Protected Places Order, 1961 is
hereby deleted.

3. Items 53 and 55 in the Schedule to the Protected Places Order, 1964
are hereby deleted.

4. Items 6, 17 and 21 in the Schedule to the Protected Places (No. 2)
Order, 1964 are hereby deleted.

5. Item 31 in the Schedule to the Protected Places (No. 3) Order, 1964
is hereby deleted.

6. Items 20 and 21 in the Schedule to the Protected Places (No. 4)
Order, 1964 are hereby deleted.

7. Item 35 in the Schedule to the Protected Places Order, 1965 is
hereby deleted.

Dated this 14th day of March, 1973.

[KHEDN /POL/34/29 /Jld. 5; (PN. (PU2.) 2 Pt. II.)]

On behalf and in the name of the Minister of Home Affairs Malaysia,

ALI BIN Hast AHMAD,
Deputy Minister of Home Affairs
